sources.title: GitHub - ayoubatouf/distilbert_sentiment_analysis
sources.snippet: The model processes the tokenized input through its embedding and transformer layers, extracting contextual information from the text. Finally, it uses a classification head (a linear layer) to map the output to the desired classes: positive or negative sentiment.
